office: the documents department (oddelenie dokladov) at the place of permanent or temporary residence or where the citizen is staying; abroad, the Slovak Republic's embassy

routes.label: a valid passport lost, damaged or stolen, the first time

note: Fees in force from 1 April 2024, paid by eKolok when applying. A replacement for a valid passport lost, damaged or stolen costs double the fee the first time (written as replacement routes), five times the second within 2 years and ten times the third within 2 years. The fee page writes the reduced periods as 'Do 10 dní' and 'Do 2 dní', the travel documents page as working days. A one-year passport costs EUR 12, 24 or 36 under 16 and EUR 45, 90 or 135 from 16.
